title: The top bar is two rows with named tab pills and state buttons
body:
The top bar is one row: the diamond, the workspace name, numbered tab buttons, a `+`, the focused pane's name, `zoom`, the agent counts and `≡`. Board A of the mockup draws a taller bar with named tabs and state buttons.

## Proposal

- `TOP` goes to 2 rows, with the bar's text drawn half a row down so it is centred.
- The workspace name is bold.
- Tabs are rounded pills, the active one filled with `SELECTION`. A pill's label is what runs in the tab's focused pane: for a terminal, the name of the shell's foreground program (`cargo`), or the last directory of the shell's cwd at the prompt (`decade`); for another client, the last part of its app id. The label is read from `/proc` through `proc.rs`, cached per pane, and reread at most every 2 s while the bar is drawn. A pill shows a state dot when an agent in the tab has reported.
- After a separator, the focused window's title, cut to the room left.
- On the right, tinted pills `! N needs you`, `✓ N done` and `● N working`, each only when N > 0. A click shows the next workspace in that state.
- Hits on the bar are in pixels.

Hover states on the bar wait for the pointer tracking the closed-sidebar rail needs.
